summary: Iter11 verified the major refactor: provably-fair flow removed, 6-deck shoe with cut-card persistence, operator JWT auth + admin panel, and unified bet pad across all 5 customer games. 20/20 new pytest cases pass, and a full Playwright run on /asiakas and /operator confirmed end-to-end UI flows.
critical_code_review_comments: blackjack3d.py is now ~1068 lines — close to the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting Shoe + DB persistence into shoe.py, leaving routes in blackjack3d.py. Not blocking.
customer.html keeps growing (~3700+ lines after chip-row additions). Extract per-game JS modules.

_persist_shoe UPDATE statement contains a no-op WHEN clause for last_shuffled (uses CASE WHEN ?=draw_index … last_shuffled ELSE last_shuffled). It always returns last_shuffled either branch — has no effect on the column. Recommend dropping the CASE or replacing with explicit logic ('only update last_shuffled when shuffles increments').

Migration table blackjack3d_games still carries legacy PF columns (server_seed/server_seed_hash/client_seed/nonce). They are written as empty strings; consider dropping them in a follow-up migration to align the schema with the new design.
Customer login API returns the player object with key 'id' (not 'player_id') — fine for the existing UI but easy to mis-test; documented for next testing agent.
test_credentials: Player BJ3D Test / test123 (id=1, ~10040 pts after iter11). Operator: password admin123 (from /app/.env).
seed_data_creation: Top-ups via /api/players/1/points/grant inside _ensure_balance helper to keep balance >= 5000 (and 20000 for the cut-card stress test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_iter11_shoe_and_operator.py and run in ~18s end-to-end against the live preview URL. Operator auth uses Bearer JWT (HS256), 60-min TTL, secret from OPERATOR_TOKEN_SECRET. /operator page renders via blackjack3d blueprint's `/operator` route. Customer login returns key 'id' (NOT 'player_id'). Stand button on the inline BJ panel is `#bj-stand` (no data-testid). Shoe persistence: every successful start increments draw_index; cut-card reshuffle is observed after enough rounds (test_cut_card_triggers_reshuffle ran 40 rounds and saw shuffles increment).
verified_features: POST /api/blackjack3d/round/start — returns shoe object, NO PF fields
Cut-card triggers reshuffle (shuffles increment over many rounds)
GET /api/operator/me no header→401, with Bearer→{ok:true, role:'operator'}
All operator endpoints reject missing token → 401

Frontend /operator: splash → wrong pw 'Väärä salasana.' → correct login → dashboard shows OPERAATTORI tag, 7 stat tiles, shoes table (1 row BJ3D Test, draw 0/234 after reset), 50 recent rounds. 'Sekoita kaikki pakat' click resets shoes; 'Kirjaudu ulos' clears operator_token in localStorage.
Frontend /asiakas Blackjack panel: bj-verify-btn GONE; HUD tag 'Blackjack · 6 pakkaa'; bj-shoe-status pill after settle reads '🃏 6 pakkaa · 2% käytetty · cut 75% · sekoituksia 6'.
All 5 customer panels (Coinflip, WAR, Baccarat, Blackjack, Pikapokeri) have unified bet pad: number input + slider + 5 chip buttons (25/100/500/1000/clear). bj chip 100×2 from min(10)=210; clear→10.
End-to-end Blackjack round: deal → stand → settle → VOITTO +10 (balance moved through wallet, observed 10040 final).
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found in this iteration.
